info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Utility Billing Disputes-v1-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Disputes API provides a comprehensive solution for retrieving a list of disputes related to utility billing. This endpoint enables consumers, such as utility providers and customer service platforms, to access essential information regarding ongoing billing disputes efficiently. Users can filter and obtain detailed records on dispute status and related customer interactions, supporting effective management and resolution. Ideal for operational teams and customer support representatives, this API enhances the dispute resolution process and improves customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details about a specific billing dispute associated with your account. You can use this information to understand the nature of the dispute and take necessary actions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to fetch billing dispute information. Ensure that the request includes the necessary parameters to specify the dispute you are querying about.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content to return.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesRequest.description: A JSON string representation of the request body for the GET operation related to billing disputes.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the dispute transaction.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state or status of the dispute.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A descriptive message regarding the operation's result.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesResponse_204.description: Response schema for a successful billing dispute operation, indicating the outcome of the request.

createdBy.description: Identifier for the user who created the dispute record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the dispute record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the dispute was created through an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Schema containing audit information for the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken by the server to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
